summary: Chronicle is a new Atlas application that renders a unified calendar heatmap from shared_views.calendar_event_view — a Blueprint-owned SQL view. All transformation happens in the database. The application provides source selection, selection persistence via a backend PATCH endpoint, heatmap rendering (inline, no Platform dependency), and day-detail interaction.

am3_resolution.format: Short lowercase string as used in shared_views.calendar_event_view: 'workout', 'food'.
am3_resolution.basis: Observed directly in 00_Blueprint/SharedViews/chronicle.sql. These are the canonical application identifiers for this view. Not the full AppRegistry appId. Frontend source key matching must use these exact strings.

owns: shared_views.calendar_source_selection (writable selection table, defined in chronicle.sql)

consumed: AtlasShell — provides routing, layout, app hosting
platform_errorhandling — logging, exception handlers, request timing
Platform.new_components_introduced: None — heatmap renderer is inline in this application. Platform extraction explicitly deferred.

owns: Chronicle frontend — ShellEntry.tsx, shellConfig.ts, CalendarPage.tsx, SourceChooser.tsx, HeatmapRenderer.tsx, DayDetailView.tsx

named_contracts.name: CalendarEventViewRow

required.name: date
required.description: Calendar day (one row per day per source)

required.name: application
required.description: Atlas application identifier — short lowercase, e.g. 'workout', 'food'

required.name: source_label
required.description: Source identity and display label, e.g. 'Workout Days', 'Protein Intake'

required.name: value
required.description: Display-ready intensity 1..100; missing day = no row, rendered as 0

required.name: selected
required.description: Persisted global selection flag, joined from calendar_source_selection

optional.name: deep_link
optional.description: URL to source application day detail

rules: One row per (application, source_label, date) — no duplicates
Rows are fully prepared in DB — no app-side aggregation or normalization
Missing day = no row — application renders as 0
Selection is backed by calendar_source_selection and exposed via the view's selected column
source_label is assumed stable within an application (MVP deferral of enforcement)

named_contracts.name: SourceListRow
named_contracts.description: Distinct (application, source_label, selected) tuples derived from CalendarEventViewRow, used to populate the SourceChooser.

contracts.non_dataset_justification: The heatmap endpoint does not return a Dataset. Dataset is optimised for paginated collection rendering (meta.total, page, page_size, row_actions). The heatmap requires date-sparse row access where missing days are rendered as 0 — Dataset pagination semantics do not apply. The CalendarEventViewRow contract (declared above) is the explicit stable contract used instead, per Atlas UI Data Contract v1.0 controlled-exception rule.

database.connection_pattern: Identical to FoodTracker — psycopg2 SimpleConnectionPool, ATLAS_PG_* env vars, backend/database.py

endpoints.description: Returns distinct (application, source_label, selected) rows from calendar_event_view. Used by SourceChooser.
Returns all rows for the given (application, source_label) from calendar_event_view, for the current calendar year. Missing days are not included — frontend renders them as 0.
Upserts selection state for a (application, source_label) pair in calendar_source_selection.

platform_dependencies: platform_contracts (Dataset, DatasetMeta, ColumnSchema — imported for consistency but CalendarEventView endpoints use named contracts, not Dataset)

routes.description: Unified calendar with source chooser and heatmap

components.name: CalendarPage
responsibilities: Auto-open first selected source (if any selected)
Render SourceChooser and conditionally render HeatmapRenderer for the active source
Pass toggle handler down to SourceChooser

components.name: SourceChooser
responsibilities: Receive sources: SourceListRow[] and onToggle handler as props
Display each source as a list item with checkmark when selected=true

components.name: HeatmapRenderer
responsibilities: On mount / when (application, source_label) changes: fetch GET /api/chronicle/calendar/events
Build a map of date -> value from the response rows
Render a year-grid heatmap (current calendar year, Mon-Sun columns, week rows)
Missing dates render as 0 (no colour / lightest shade)
values 1..100 render with intensity scaling (5 intensity levels: 0, 1-25, 26-50, 51-75, 76-100)
On day click: show DayDetailView for that date (or empty state if value=0)
Inline implementation only — no Platform component dependency

design_decisions.year_range: Current calendar year (Jan 1 to Dec 31). Year determined at page load from client Date.
design_decisions.empty_state_for_zero: Value=0 days are rendered as the lightest shade cell with no interaction (no detail view shown for 0-value days).
design_decisions.layout: 52 columns (weeks) x 7 rows (Mon-Sun). Month labels above columns. Day-of-week labels on left.

components.name: DayDetailView
responsibilities: Receive a CalendarEventViewRow (or null) as prop
Display: date, application, source_label, label, value
Display detail and deep_link if present
Render nothing (null) when prop is null

data_flow.event_data: CalendarPage (active source) -> HeatmapRenderer -> GET /api/chronicle/calendar/events?application=X&source_label=Y -> CalendarEventViewRow[] -> date->value map -> grid render
data_flow.selection_toggle: SourceChooser click -> CalendarPage.handleToggle -> PATCH /api/chronicle/calendar/sources -> optimistic update sources list + re-fetch events if needed
data_flow.day_detail: HeatmapRenderer day click -> CalendarPage.selectedDay state -> DayDetailView render

invariants: No transformation logic in the application. All aggregation is in the Blueprint SQL view.
No app-side normalization of values. Values are consumed as-is from the view.
No Platform component introduced for the heatmap renderer in this sprint.
source_label immutability is not enforced in MVP — a stale selection against a changed label will silently orphan (known, deferred).
One source rendered at a time — no multi-source rendering, no swimlanes.
Selection is global (single-user assumption) — no per-user preferences.
Application field values in the view are short lowercase strings ('workout', 'food') — not full AppRegistry appIds.
open_decisions_for_implementer: Am-2 (auto-open when no source selected): Show empty heatmap area with SourceChooser visible and a prompt message. No auto-open on first use.
Non-quantitative / value=0 day clicking: Do not show DayDetailView for 0-value days.
